name: Heri-Zhang 2026: drift, gaussian short pulse (1D)
description:
Paper-parameter PIC example; exact reproduction is not claimed. Nominal FWHM tau=k*T; equal total injected charge for all three profiles. Trapezoid ramp fraction 0.15 and Gaussian cutoff are inferred, not reported inputs. The paper FWHM-label and full-support arrival-span metrics must be distinguished. History electrode currents are collected currents; the paper induced current requires sum(|q|*w*vz)/D. Drift charge uses the explicitly documented small-spacing interpretation Q/A=4*f*eps0*V0/D. The paper Eq.(5) amplitude initialization and Eq.(11) field normalization are unresolved: f=0.95 may reflect in this physical model. The installed emitter has a small relativistic-momentum offset with a nonrelativistic pusher at 1 keV. See SHORT_PULSE_EXAMPLES.md. Source DOI 10.1109/TED.2026.3670804.

Pulse setup: edit named values under Parameters, and the expression under Emission > pulse > Current density [A/m^2]. t is solver time [s]; u=t+sample_dt/2 samples the midpoint of the current step. The where((u>=0)&(u<support),1,0) gate emits only for 0 <= u < support; & means both comparisons must hold. Keep emitter t_start=0, t_stop=support and simulation dt=sample_dt. support is full pulse duration [s]; tau=k*T is FWHM [s]. Jamp=pulse_charge_per_area/pulse_area_time is peak current density [A/m^2], not total current. pulse_charge_per_area=f*sigma_ref [C/m^2]; pulse_area_time is the integral of the dimensionless pulse shape [s]. sample_dt=support/ceil(support/(dt_fraction*T)) aligns support to whole steps; dt_fraction=0.0002 is the requested maximum step / T. Gaussian: center=support/2, shape=exp(-0.5*((u-support/2)/sigma_t)**2), where u=t+sample_dt/2. sigma_t=tau/(2*sqrt(2*log(2))) is the time standard deviation; support=2*gaussian_cutoff_sigma*sigma_t. Cutoff is 2.5 sigma (diode) or 2 sigma (drift). pulse_area_time=sigma_t*sqrt(2*pi)*gaussian_retained_fraction; gaussian_retained_fraction=erf(gaussian_cutoff_sigma/sqrt(2)). The evaluator has no erf: update this numerical fraction together with the cutoff. Use cutoff > sqrt(2*log(2)) so tau remains the retained pulse FWHM.
Current density expression: Jamp*(exp(-0.5*(((t+sample_dt/2)-support/2)/sigma_t)**2))*where(((t+sample_dt/2)>=0)&((t+sample_dt/2)<support),1,0)
